finding.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
finding.summary: delete_account is registered in urls.py with no require_POST/require_http_methods restriction, so it deletes the authenticated user's account on a plain GET request; Django's CsrfViewMiddleware only validates unsafe methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), so the GET-reachable state change is never checked for a CSRF token even though the middleware is correctly enabled.
